Synopsis:
    Chile's CPI rose 0.6% MoM in August 2026, double the consensus forecast of 0.3% and the fastest pace since April. Annual inflation jumped to 4.1%, breaching the central bank's 3% ±1pp tolerance band. Key drivers were food/beverages (+1.4%) and transport (+1.6%). Analysts expect inflation expectations to drift higher, partly due to El Niño effects. Chile's central bank was expected to hold its benchmark rate at 4.5% at a meeting the same day, with analysts calling for a cautious policy stance.
